description: This PHP class defines a specific display field for work experience data within the HRM reporting module of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base listable display field class and provides methods to specify associated DTO class, entity aliases, and fields.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: A report display field class representing work experience data, providing methods to retrieve DTO class, entity aliases, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity alias names used in this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields that this display field represents.
